purpose: Selected-vehicle location overview combining the latest known position, recent trail, location presence, navigation links, replay and position history.
primaryGoal: Understand where the selected vehicle was last observed and inspect or replay its recent GPS evidence without confusing retained historical coordinates with a current live fix.

dataSources.name: Fleet identity and workspace vehicle
dataSources.behavior: Shared vehicles query, safeArray normalization and abort signal. Selection follows path/query/store/fleet fallback. Page does not render a competing vehicle picker.

dataSources.name: Latest known position
dataSources.behavior: Enabled with selected vehicle; polls every 15 seconds. Backend reads a 30-day default signal timeline, reverses newest-first and limits after reversal. This is durable history, not a proven fresh live-state read. Page marks successful receipts live without observation-age cutoff.

dataSources.name: Recent position history
dataSources.behavior: Separate non-interval query feeds trail, replay and table; history defaults to []; skips absent/zero-pair coordinates for map/replay and sorts replay ascending. No workspace date filter or full-result export is introduced by this page.

dataSources.name: Location presence
dataSources.behavior: Reads live.LiveState and only projects present fields; no page-specific polling interval. Home/work are tri-state; missing HomeLink currently becomes false. Handler emits no timestamp/freshness envelope here.

dataSources.name: Basemap provider
dataSources.behavior: Five-minute config cache, configured Azure/Google or free OSM/Esri/OpenTopoMap tiles. Low-bandwidth mode substitutes dark tiles and defers requests until gestures settle; attribution remains. Tile/config failure UI is not supplied by this component.

dataSources.name: Global live-pipe health
dataSources.endpoint: Not directly requested by this page; connection hook transport not traced
dataSources.behavior: Shows polite stale warning after a continuous two-minute reconnect/disconnect period. This describes pipe health, not the age of the position observation.

components.detail: Existing width/container adapter and shell-owned header/actions; query and four dataSources forwarded.
Five source-backed metrics, scope, receipt freshness, provenance and retained/unavailable/partial labels; optional retry not supplied by this page.
Category-barrel imports; local non-exported StatusRow composes repeated presence/value rows.
Shared Leaflet boundary; existing resizing observer, provider selection and playback retained.
Source-specific initial/error/empty branches, localized explanations and retries.
Replay play/pause/reset, speed and seek remain existing shared presentation. Global shortcut opt-in defaults false; scrubber internals were not inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local latest/history/location queries duplicate endpoint access already represented by useVehiclePositions at useVehicles.ts:291-297 and useLocationSnapshotLatest at :491-498. The latter uses numeric vehicle ID while this page uses string ID in a similarly named key. Shared positions key omits limit, so blindly replacing both local queries would alias limit=1 and limit=50.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Extend the existing domain hook contract to represent independent latest/history limits, cancellation and refresh policies while explicitly preserving existing cache identities and invalidations; do not create a second map data layer.

sourceBehavior: Page:322-327 stacks the hero at small widths; xl makes map two of three columns. Map heights are 380/460/600px.
Page:423-452 quick links wrap labels and have min-h-11 targets.
Page:488-497 uses mobileColumns time/speed/heading with pagination and stable tableId.
RoutePlayback.tsx:341-343,420-435 keeps a fixed 360px requested map and shared transport beneath it; layer labels hide below sm.

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043: full mobile detail preservation
issues.detail: Latitude/longitude history columns are excluded from the mobile allow-list. DataTable.tsx:238-246,725 hides omitted cells below md. Page provides neither mobilePresentation nor expandable row details, so historical coordinates are not directly visible on small screens.
issues.fix: Use the existing DataTable mobile detail/card contract or accessible per-row expansion to keep all coordinates reachable; preserve tableId, ordering, pagination, timestamps and raw rows.

issues.rule: MDC-040 / MDC-043: touch targets and narrow controls
issues.detail: Switcher uses px-2 py-1 text-xs and no explicit 44px minimum. Four emoji-only choices below sm are named but actual hit size, long-label fit, overlap with attribution and 320px/200%-text behavior remain unmeasured.
issues.fix: Extend the existing switcher using density-aware target sizing, visible focus and wrapping/compact layout; retain all four choices and aria-pressed.

responsive.runtime: UNVERIFIED: no viewport, overflow, touch, zoom, RTL or resize interaction exercised.

sourceStrengths: Page:325-326 names the live map region; marker popup names the vehicle at :347.
StatusRow:88 hides decorative icons; labels and yes/no/unknown text accompany badge color.
MapLayerSwitcher.tsx:22-24,41-59 has labelled group, native buttons, localized names, type=button and aria-pressed.
RoutePlayback.tsx:342-350 associates a hidden route summary with a labelled application region; map animation flags and FitTrail consult reduced motion.
LiveStaleDataBanner.tsx:79-81 uses role=status and polite announcement.

issues.rule: MDC-040 / MDC-042: map motion and nonvisual equivalence
issues.detail: Hero MapContainer does not pass reduced-motion flags or a route summary, unlike shared RoutePlayback. Live coordinates and history provide text alternatives, but mobile omits row coordinates. Leaflet defaults and map keyboard reachability are not verified.
issues.fix: Compose the existing useMotionPreference and route-summary mechanisms without replacing Leaflet or deleting trail/navigation. Validate keyboard entry/exit, popup focus and actual reduced-motion pan/zoom.

accessibility.runtime: UNVERIFIED: keyboard, screen reader, focus visibility/order, effective text/UI contrast, forced colors, target dimensions and animation behavior.

states.loading: Page:289 suppresses page only while fleet initially loads with no independent data; map, location, replay and table use contextual skeletons (:329-330,370-371,461-462,483-484).
states.empty: NoVehicleSelected guard :277-279 waits for resolved nonfailed fleet; GPS/no location :356-363 and :417-418; insufficient replay :472-476; empty history explanation :500-507. Sections stay mounted after ordinary data resolution.
states.failure: fatalError only drives per-source QueryError with retry (:333,373,464,486). Page-level fleet fatal error is gated on no independent retained sources (:290).
states.retainedPartialOffline: deriveDataState preserves retained values and PageContainer renders DataSourceNotice. Four page descriptors :292-297 keep independent source recovery. Brief :24-33 labels retained/partial/unavailable. LiveStaleDataBanner describes global transport outage, not GPS freshness.

issues.rule: MDC-025 / MDC-026: unknown is not false
issues.detail: homelink_nearby ?? false renders No (:397-403) when the backend omits this field, while home/work correctly use triLabel. Latest handler only emits existing signals, so absent HomeLink is a real possible shape.
issues.fix: Use the same boolean/undefined tri-state label and neutral unknown treatment; retain true and measured false distinctly.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045: source provenance and observation freshness
issues.detail: Latest position is durable history with up to 30-day lookback but is marked live on every successful poll. deriveDataState receives no maxAgeMs and measures receipt time, not created_at. Healthy SSE and fresh HTTP receipt cannot prove recent GPS evidence. LocationDetails also lacks exposed observation timestamps.
issues.fix: Label latest-known historical position honestly and distinguish observation from receipt age using existing trust mechanisms. Coordinate a typed source freshness contract before claiming live GPS. Keep old genuine coordinates visible.

issues.detail: A successful empty latest array becomes null and then undefined for deriveDataState, which returns initial rather than unavailable. Empty history [] counts as retained data and ok without unavailable annotation. Map/table empty UI exists, but source and brief trust labels can disagree with it.
issues.fix: Represent resolved emptiness explicitly through the existing unavailable contract, without fabricating measurements or losing retained-data/error behavior.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-034 / mission 5: neon map line
visualIssues.detail: Hero trail hardcodes electric cyan #00f0ff, independently of theme/chart palettes.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing restrained map/chart semantic accent while preserving route contrast, weight, opacity and every point; do not overwrite saved theme/chart choices.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-042: neon, glow, pure-white decoration
visualIssues.detail: Default marker #00f0ff; :48 pulses indefinitely; :52 uses border:2px solid white and :53 adds colored glow. These are inherited shared decoration, not page CSS. Global OS reduced-motion override exists at index.css:1404-1414; low-bandwidth marker pulse suppression was not established.
visualIssues.fix: Extend existing safe marker factory with subdued theme-aware accent/border and non-glowing default; preserve sanitizeColor, anchor geometry, visibility and caller-provided semantic/custom colors. Remove ambient pulse or honor existing motion policy.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-015 / MDC-034: independent decorative palette and surfaces
visualIssues.detail: Replay defaults use hardcoded cyan/blue colors; :375-389 uses fixed start/end semantic hues; :405 adds backdrop blur and shadow-lg; :421 uses border-white/[0.06]. Replay GlassPanel is nested inside page LayoutCard (:460), adding stacked surface chrome.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing semantic map palette and surface/border tokens; consider an opt-in embedded/unframed variant of the existing replay renderer. Keep start/end distinction, controls, map, overlays and default compatibility.

visualIssues.detail: Odometer icon has an unconditional purple-400 accent. Presence icons also use fixed emerald/cyan shades; text and badges carry their semantic meaning. No page fixed-white body text or glowing card class was found.
visualIssues.fix: Use muted icon tokens for nonsignal decoration and semantic tokens for measured state; check composed contrast instead of declaring every saturated icon a failure.

architectureIssues.detail: All three local queryFns omit TanStack signal forwarding. Latest polling uses fixed 15_000 rather than the existing refresh policy. Shared useVehicles forwards signal; positions/location hooks also already do.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate with the existing hook/query-policy owners, retaining query keys, disabled prerequisites, latest/history separation and established refresh behavior; verify hidden/offline/low-bandwidth policy explicitly.

architectureIssues.detail: Page passes PositionRecord.speed unchanged at :194, but replay chip prints raw fmtNumber(cp.speed) plus literal km/h. Page's other speed displays call useUnits.formatSpeed. Backend maps VehicleSpeed to a misleading speed_mph name and aliases that value to speed; no conversion occurs in the inspected handler. Exact runtime value/unit was not established.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm canonical VehicleSpeed semantics with SI/data owner, type PlaybackPoint.speed accordingly and format through existing useUnits at display boundary. Do not add a legacy converter or mutate wire/cache values.

architectureIssues.detail: PositionRecord.id is declared number while backend sets id to fmt.Sprintf(timestamp) at vehicle/handler.go:260. vehicle_id is declared required but not assigned in the inspected Positions response loop. LocationSnapshot requires id/created_at/active_route although Latest projects only available mapped signals and does not emit these fields. Optional odometer is not in the position mapping; UI properly formats missing value as unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Align shared typed response contracts to actual endpoints and optional measurements before hook adoption; preserve stable row identity and null handling. Keep unsupported odometer displayed as unknown rather than inventing zero.

architectureIssues.detail: Quick links use window.location.hash assignments rather than existing router links/navigation. Routes/actions are preserved source strings; hash-router compatibility, back behavior and modifier-click are not exercised.
architectureIssues.fix: Compose existing router-aware link/button pattern while retaining exact destinations and accessible names; confirm router mode before changing behavior.

priority.reason: Resolve source-trust, missing-boolean and replay-unit risks before cosmetic modernization. Preserve the substantial existing operational brief, hero/context, replay and table implementation.
order: typed SI and observation freshness integration
shared marker/replay palette and surface restraint

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing vehicle position/location query contract integration
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Retain independent latest limit=1 and history limit=50 reads, vehicle identity and query-key migration/invalidation compatibility; cancellation signal; polling policy; typed optional fields/string position ID; unavailable versus initial; receipt versus observation timestamps and retained/fatal/refresh errors.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing map marker presentation contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Safe caller color support, restrained default/border, no ambient glow, reduced-motion and low-bandwidth handling, unchanged marker dimensions/anchors and popup behavior.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing RoutePlayback display and embedding contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Explicit SI speed interpretation with useUnits display conversion; current points, optional speed/soc/power, height, layer/style/color options, autoPlay and onPositionChange preserved; opt-in unframed embedding if justified; localized units, semantic endpoints and reduced-motion behavior.
dependsOn: web\src\hooks\useUnits.ts contract (import/use inspected through page only)

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing map layer switcher target/focus contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: current/onChange unchanged; dark/satellite/streets/terrain; labelled pressed states, density-aware minimum target, visible focus, compact and long-label layouts, forced-colors retention.

competingImplementations.detail: Page-local position/location query access competes with existing domain hooks; reuse with explicit contract extension rather than new hook families.
Hero URL layer and replay local layer state are independently scoped existing controls, not proven duplicates. Replay starts dark independently of URL layer.
competingImplementations.fix: Preserve both scopes and defaults unless an explicit product contract changes them; do not consolidate and lose independent replay selection.

competingImplementations.detail: Already uses canonical PageLayout, LayoutCard and OperationalBrief pipeline. No replacement card/layout/theme/stat engine is needed.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse current category exports and improve owners only where concrete gaps are documented.

actions: Header-owned selected-vehicle filtering and URL/store precedence
Hero layer URL parameter: layer=dark|satellite|streets|terrain, default dark
Map pan, zoom/scroll-wheel and vehicle popup
Source retries and independent recovery through DataSourceNotice/QueryError
Recent history pagination and shared table persistence; tableId maps:overview-history
dataBehavior: Never drop genuine retained coordinates/history on refresh failure.
Keep separate latest-one and recent-50 sources; history is not promised to refresh every 15 seconds.
Keep newest-first table/trail and ascending timestamp replay.
Keep no GPS, insufficient replay, empty fleet/history and per-source error explanations.
Keep home/work unknown separate from measured false; correct missing HomeLink without deleting status row.
Keep source speed/heading/coordinates/timestamp and optional odometer/battery/power; no SI wire/cache conversion.
Preserve all five history columns on desktop and make omitted mobile detail reachable.
Retain configured basemap providers, attribution, low-bandwidth substitution and tile resize observation.
Keep all six content sections; no single data gate or cosmetic reduction.
Do not invent a date filter, realtime transport, full-result export or live GPS guarantee not supplied by the current page.
